· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.4894 → -12.2130): bearish convergence, strengthening downtrend.

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($1530.64): based on Pivot S2 and 52-week low.
· Swing resistance level ($1896.35): 20-day high and R2 level.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (downside pressure within accumulation): RSI entering oversold and MACD worsening increase downside potential, maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
